paite: Amaziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua vai ahawm a; anu min Jehoaddan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah / (2 Kum 14.2-6)

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih a, himahleh alungsim ape bukim kei hi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, agam ahong dinkip in apa thattu, sikhate athat hi.

Himahleh atate uh bel athat kei a, Mosi Dan laibu a tuang, "Tate ziak in pate asi ding uh ahi kei, pate ziak in tate asi ding uh ahi sam kei, michih amau gitlouhna ziak in asi ding uh ahi,” chi a TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.

Amaziah in Judahte akaikhawm a, Judah leh Benjamin mi tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in sangkhat heutu leh zakhat heutute nuai ah a-omsak hi. Kum sawmnih tunglam teng asim a, mi teltuam, tei leh lum tawi thei, galkap thei mi nuaithum a-om uhi.
Huan Israel gam a mi, mihat hangsan nuaikhat dangka talent zakhat in aguai lai hi.
heading: Edomte Toh Kidouna / (2 Kum 14.7)

paite: Himahleh, akiang ah Pathian mi, mi khat ahong a, "Aw Kumpipa, Israel sepaihte na kiang ah pai kei le uh, TOUPA Israel mite, Ephraim suante huam in, na kiang ah a-om kei hi.

Hoh hi lechin leng, hangtak in kidouna ah gamtang in: huchi lou in zaw Pathian in melma mai ah nang a hon vuallelsak ding: Pathian in lah panpih theihna leh vuallelhsak theihna anei ngal a," ahong chi hi.

Huchi in Amaziah in Pathian mipa kiang ah, "Ahihleh Israel sepaihte ka piaksa talent zakhat bang i chihta dia awi?" achi a. Huan Pathian mipa'n, "TOUPA'N huai sang a tampi nang ahon pe thei ahi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Amaziah in Ephraim gam a kipan a sepaih hong paite paikik ding in akhen a; huaiziak in Judate tung ah aheh mahmah ua, hehtak in apaikikta uhi.
Amaziah in lunglel lou in mite apikhia a, Chi Phaizang ah ahoh ua, Seir suante singkhat athat uhi.
Singkhat dang Judate'n ahingmat ua, suangpi vum ah api ua, suangpi vum a kipan in asawnkhe mengmeng ua, akitamzangawp uhi.
Himahleh Amaziah in akiang ah galkap ding a pai lou ding a asawlkik sepaihte'n Judah gam khuate, Samaria a kipan a Beth-horon pha in asual ua, mi sangthum athat ua, gallak tampi ala uhi.
Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, Amaziah, Edomte that ahong pai in Seir suante' pathiante ahon pua a, apathian ding in apangsak a, huchi in abia ua, gimlimte ahalsak chiat hi.
Huaiziak in Amaziah tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta a, akiang ah zawlnei asawl a, huai mi in akiang ah, "Na khut a kipan a amite hunkhe thei lou nam pathiante bang ding mahmah a zong na hia?" achi hi.

Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, akiang a thu agen lai in kumpipa'n, "Kumpipa vaihawmpa ding in nang ka hon bawl ua hia? Dai mai in: bang ding a na hinna tan ding na hia?" achi a. Huchi in zawlnei in, "Pathian in hichibang a na hih ziak leh ka thuhilhna na ngaihkhiak louh ziak in nang hihmang lungsim in anei chih ka thei hi, achi a," adaita hi.
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Amaziah in thuhilh apom a, Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa, Jehoahaz tapa, Joash kiang ah, "Hong dih, kimatuah in i ki-en ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
heading: Israelte Toh Kidouna

paite: Israel kumpipa Joash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, "Ka tapa zi ding in na tanu neisak dih, chi in athukhak a; huan, Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, ling ahong chilpukgawp hi.

'Nang ngai dih, Edom ka zou,' na chi a, na lungsim in na kisathei a, na inn ah om kinken mai in; nang leh Judah gam nangawn a siatna, nang dia poi ding thil bangziak a tokkhe ding na hia?" chi in mi asawl hi.
Himahleh, Amaziah in angaikhe nuam kei a; Edomte pathiante azon ziak a, Judah gam a amelmate uh khut a apiaktheihna ding a Pathian hih ahi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa Joash ahohtou a; Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah kimaituah in aki-enta ngei uhi.
Huan Israelte sang in Judate tan ahong sezaw a; michih amau inn lam chiat ah apaita uhi.

Israel kumpipa Joash in Beth-shemesh ah Judah kumpipa, Ahaziah tapa Jehoahaz tapa Amaziah aman a, Jerusalem ah api a, Jerusalem kulh Ephraim kulh kongpi a kipan akulh ning kongpi tan in tong zali tak achimsak hi.
Huan TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn agou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, henta koltang dingte toh, huan, Samaria kholam ah apaikik nawnta hi.
Huchi in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah bel Israelte kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Joash sih nung in kum sawm-le-nga adam lai hi.
heading: Amaziah Sihna

paite: Amaziah thilhih dangte abul a pan atawp tan in ngai dih, Judah kumpite leh Israel kumpite thugelhnabu ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Amaziah in TOUPA zuih atawpsantak in Jerusalem ah thah asawm ua, Lakish ah atai a; himahleh khua ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athat uhi.
Aluang sakol in apua ua, api-le-pute kiang Judah khopi ah avui uhi.
